query: SELECT f.product_id, COALESCE(f.observed_hash, f.hash) AS digest, COALESCE(f.observed_byte_len, b.byte_len) AS byte_len, COALESCE(f.payload_file_name, f.name) AS file_name FROM product_file f LEFT JOIN blob b ON b.org_id = f.org_id AND b.hash = f.hash WHERE f.org_id = $1 AND f.role = 'payload' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.product_id = ANY($2)
